name: Himemiya Yuki
source:
Hobbies: Tea parties, walking
Likes: All kinds of tea (especially herbal tea)
Dislikes: Snakes, insects

The student council president who is also a rich girl to boot, Yuki is the most popular girl at school. However, she is tired of her life and wishes to find new things or ways that'll excite her.
